name: זְאֵב
summary: Zeeb and Oreb commanded Midian’s forces. The Ephraimites captured them and killed Zeeb at the place called the winepress of Zeeb.

evidence.note: The commander and the winepress bear the same name.
The same word names the wolf in Jacob’s words about Benjamin.

note: The personal name and the common noun are identical in spelling and pointing. Judges gives no account of how Zeeb received his name.
